adapter: Reuse unchanged Maxwell capture module. wr_valid && drain_enable -> fence.cap_valid; fence.cap_ready && drain_enable -> capture.wr_ready. capture.ack_ready gates fence actual host_ACK_ready; both retire same real ACK edge. Consumer requires capture.consumer_eligible after actual RF operand read, optional scratch, x SRAM writes and matrix barrier release.

capture_budget.selected_policy: reuse source-bound full-one-op reservation from parent bench; product streaming collector still parent owned

dependent_chain_price: Two sequential all-vector passes, 2*nvec actual full128 operations. Original no-hold SIMD12cycle/14II is a component reference only; test completion holds and actual handshake gaps must be measured separately. End-to-end = actual next issue - actual producer first/last result, not12cycles. Optional scratch8 writes+8 reads, native xwrite/prefetch, bank/ACK/barrier/weight waits included once.

interface.ACK_backpressure: ack_retire_enable, diagnostic/controller readiness; accepted writes remain pending until actual ACK handshake
interface.capture: cap_valid/cap_ready;cap_epoch8;cap_addr9 must equal issued-vector index0..expected-1;cap_last1;cap_data4096. Stable until ready; no duplicate/gap destination.
interface.fence: writes_visible;fence_valid/fence_ready/fence_epoch8; consumer release only after all ACKs retired AND producer_done
interface.producer: producer_done_valid/producer_done_epoch8, one epoch-tagged completion pulse after actual producer drain
interface.vector_visibility: vector_ACK_visible plus ACK_addr9/epoch8; backed by actual service ACK, never invented timer

latency.RF_SIMD_alias_chain: matrix capture -> visible mirrored RF writes -> ADD(x,x)->sameaddr -> ADD(prior,prior)->sameaddr -> RF read -> optional scratch -> actual nextmatrix xwrite -> firstissue; no host overwrite between dependent ops
latency.invalid_epoch_count_last: not accepted; sticky fault until reset; never advance fence from rejected/stale input
latency.price: Reuse existing RFwriteII2; count measured fence/producer/bank/backpressure delays once on actual event DAG; no extra blanket200ns term
latency.reset: reset invalidates pending ACK/control/epoch, not SRAM contents; next operation initializes its vectors from actual matrix producer before reading

ownership.RF_visibility_fence_and_tests: this RF owner; no duplicate result capture RTL
ownership.matrix_result_capture: Maxwell/parent, existing bounded full-operation capture reused unchanged

physical_boundary_note: capture data routes directly to existing RF write bus, not8192bits of internal RF reads across matrix boundary; no additional memory copy
product_capture_area_source: Maxwell r3 full4096 reservation with seen/complete/per-vector count ledgers and payload; original prebuild register payload costs0.795mm2 DS/1.590mm2 Qwen plus metadata/mux/control. No fit claim; experimental provider only.
